text:
mira: Heads up — minimal quickstart sample (rb and go) is flaking with 401s after token rotation. repro steps below.

mira: Logs show `ERR 401` on the streaming socket right after refresh: 
```
stream: connected
auth: token rotated
stream: recv error: 401 Unauthorized (token expired)
```

mira: Steps I used: `git clone .../sampleapp-rb && RB_TOKEN=shortlived ./start-stream.sh` then trigger refresh from admin UI. Happens ~30-60s after rotation.

alex: thanks — does the non-streaming (sync) client handle refresh fine?

mira: sync works: new requests get new token. Only streaming path drops and doesn't retry.

sam: likely parity bug: rb client opens socket with `Authorization` once and doesn't apply header swap to reconnect logic. go client has explicit `RefreshTransport` wrapper.

toni: can you paste the snippet where stream reconnect code runs?

mira: sure — simplified: 
```
# ruby sampleapp
socket = TCPSocket.new(host, port)
socket.write("GET /stream HTTP/1.1\r\nAuthorization: Bearer #{token}\r\n\r\n")
# token rotates later but reconnection still uses cached headers
```

sam: yep. quick fix is to make reconnect read `current_token()` not `initial_token`. also add a jittered backoff with attempt cap.

toni: I can open a tiny PR to patch reconnect path + add unit test. will follow existing retry semantics (exponential backoff, 3 attempts).

toni: proposed diff: 
```
- headers = @initial_headers
+ headers = fetch_auth_headers()
```

toni: and add a unit that simulates token rotation by swapping token provider at runtime.

alex: please also update CHANGELOG and add a note in sampleapp README about quickstart using refreshable tokens for streams.

ci-bot: PR #562 opened by toni: rb/stream-reconnect-refresh-token (checks: lint, unit, integration).

ci-bot: integration failed: `stream-reconnect-test` timed out (flaky env).

toni: rerunning; I pushed small sleep tweak to test to stabilize.

ci-bot: integration passed.

alex: nice. can someone do a quick compatibility check vs go client? parity should be identical semantics.

sam: I ran a local smoke: go and rb stream reconnect behave the same now. will add cross-language test in e2e harness.

mira: landed locally, verified sampleapp quickstart no longer 401s after rotation. thanks! :raised_hands: 

toni: will cherry-pick to `v0.7.x` maintenance branch and open release PR.

mira: leaving this thread for QA to pick up regression test. @qa-team tagging for visibility.

alex: wrapping up: add docs note + small onboarding tweak in quickstart to mention ephemeral token caveats.

mira: +1. closing when QA confirms. :thumbsup:
